headline: Shein Agrees to $100M Settlement in US FTC Probe
summary: Fast-fashion group Shein has agreed to pay $100 million to settle a US Federal Trade Commission probe amidst regulatory scrutiny.
why: Shein is a major global online fast-fashion retailer facing international regulatory and tax compliance challenges.

impacts.name: Retail E-Commerce
impacts.why: Regulatory settlements set compliance precedents for cross-border e-commerce platforms operating in Western markets.
